about: The cutscene player's scenes (pc/src/cutscene.cpp, pc/docs/Cutscene_Player.md): how each is reached. recipe kind new_game: at the title menu, Start (the cursor on New Game); warp: from the field, the Room Browser's warp with the room's scripts and enemies on; ending: from the field, the developer jump into the ending. reliable: reached and seen to play every time; event: the event id a scan saw ((source << 12) | file). Warp entries come from pc/tools/cutscene_scan.py.

scenes.name: Opening (New Game)
scenes.from: the title menu with the cursor on New Game (an empty card, or move it there)
scenes.notes: The prologue: narration over the manor, the knights, Ashley's entry; the first talk bubbles. The test checkpoints opening / first_bubble take the same route.

scenes.name: Ending (credits, MISSION COMPLETE)
scenes.from: any field room with no event running (a loaded game)
scenes.notes: ENDING.PRG: the credits over the illustrations, then the score screen. About 27,400 frames; Start skips them.
